_meta.description: ILA Fraud Pattern Templates — evaluated by services/pattern_matcher.py

schema.name: Human-readable template name (shown in alerts)
schema.alert_type: Maps to AlertType enum in models/__init__.py
schema.conditions: List of field-level rules (ALL must match unless 'mode' is 'any')
schema.mode: 'all' (default) = all conditions must match; 'any' = at least one
schema.severity: low | medium | high | critical — baseline risk level if matched
schema.tags: Free-form tags for filtering in the dashboard

templates.name: Mule Account Velocity Pattern
templates.description: Detects mule accounts that receive and rapidly forward UPI funds. Classic pattern: high inbound transaction count, many unique senders, fast forwarding (low balance dwell time), multiple recipient accounts.

conditions.description: 20+ transactions in 1 hour — far above normal individual rate
Funds forwarded to 10+ different accounts — fan-out behaviour
Transaction amounts deviate > 2 std from entity baseline
Pattern is specific to UPI and phone-linked identifiers

templates.name: Coordinated Inauthentic Posting
templates.description: Multiple accounts posting near-identical content within a short time window. Hallmarks: high post frequency, very low unique content ratio, low reply ratio (broadcast-only behaviour), multiple platforms active simultaneously.

conditions.description: 30+ posts in 1 hour — humanly difficult to sustain
< 5% of posts are replies — pure broadcast, no engagement
60%+ of posts contain threat keywords — on-message bot
Active on 2+ platforms simultaneously — cross-platform campaign

templates.name: SIM Swap Fraud
templates.description: SIM swap precursor pattern: sudden spike in UPI login attempts from a different device, combined with high transaction velocity immediately after. Often preceded by phishing messages requesting OTP.

conditions.description: Burst of transactions immediately after SIM change
Transaction amounts far above the entity's normal range
Funds sent to 3+ new recipients (attacker-controlled accounts)
Device fingerprint changed in last 24 hours — SIM swap indicator

templates.name: Phishing Domain Cluster
templates.description: Cluster of newly-registered domains with high visual similarity to legitimate Indian banking / government portals (sbi, hdfc, uidai, irctc patterns). Linked to a common registrant entity, burst-registered within a short window.

conditions.description: Domain name is ≥75% similar to a known legitimate domain (edit distance)
Domain registered within the last 30 days
Registrant controls 3+ suspicious domains — bulk registration
50%+ of content on the domain matches phishing keyword templates

templates.name: Crypto-to-UPI Layering Network
templates.description: Detects the crypto→UPI layering pattern used for money laundering: crypto received to a wallet, converted via P2P exchange, then rapidly distributed to mule UPI accounts. Signature: crypto wallet co-occurrence with high-velocity UPI accounts in the same entity graph cluster.

conditions.description: Entity has at least one crypto wallet alias
Entity also has at least one UPI VPA alias (cross-type linkage)
High UPI transaction velocity after crypto receipt
Within 2 hops of a known flagged entity in the Neo4j graph

templates.name: Hawala Network Node
templates.description: Identifies potential hawala broker nodes: entities that act as intermediaries with high in-degree and out-degree in the transaction graph, operating across multiple cities, with no legitimate business profile.

conditions.description: High transaction throughput
High fan-out (broker distributing to many)
High betweenness centrality in entity graph — broker position
Unusual transaction amounts for stated profile

templates.name: Radicalization Content Amplifier
templates.description: Accounts that systematically amplify extremist or radicalizing content: high post frequency, consistently negative sentiment, high keyword hit rate on watchlist terms, and evidence of cross-platform coordination.

conditions.description: Average sentiment ≤ -0.60 — consistently hostile/fear-inducing content
40%+ of posts match radicalisation/extremism keywords
High posting volume — amplification behaviour
Low engagement — broadcasting, not conversing

templates.name: OTP Harvesting Scam
templates.description: Accounts or numbers that send bulk messages containing OTP-solicitation patterns. Detects the social engineering phase of financial fraud before the transaction layer.

conditions.description: Bulk messaging volume (50+ messages/hour)
70%+ messages match OTP/phishing keyword patterns
Applies to communication identifiers only
Almost zero replies — pure outbound spam
